title: Launcher and temp-audit scripts silently exit 0 when invoked through a symlinked path (macOS CI)
outcome: scripts/test-launcher.mjs and scripts/test-temp.mjs run their main path whenever they are the invoked entry point, including through a symlinked or junctioned path, so macOS CI runs the gates instead of skipping them and exiting 0.
acceptance: A regression test invokes each script through a symlinked (or, on Windows, junctioned) directory and asserts that main ran and that the exit status is not a silent 0
The macOS CI failures from run 35909418385 at dcd034a (tests 27, 28, 30, 31, 42) pass, and Windows and Linux stay green
scripts/test-launcher.mjs compares a realpath-normalized process.argv[1] with its own module path, so invocation through a symlinked directory runs main
scripts/test-temp.mjs uses the same realpath-normalized entry-point comparison
